title: Real-time Stock and Options API Data - SteadyAPI.com
author: cliffngong
selftext: SteadyAPI Finance API provides real-time and historical stock market data, company financial statements, insider and institutional trading data, earnings releases, and more. We provide comprehensive coverage of US and international markets, including equities, indices, funds, derivatives, OTC securities, and crypto.
